# Free Knowledge Institute

> Free Knowledge Institute champions digital commons, democratic technology, and open-source alternatives to platform capitalism and techno-authoritarianism.

FKI is a European non-profit organization with two decades of experience building collaborative technologies and advocating for digital sovereignty. The institute develops projects like CommonsCloud and Goteo while publishing critical analysis on BigTech monopolies and their threats to democratic governance.

## Critical Analysis & Democratic Technology

- [Democratic Technology: Building Alternatives to Techno-Authoritarianism](https://freeknowledge.eu/democratic-technology-building-alternatives-to-techno-auhtoritarianism): Analysis of democratic technology alternatives to platform capitalism and techno-authoritarianism
- [How BigTech Dismantles Democratic Foundations](https://freeknowledge.eu/how-bigtech-dismantles-democratic-foundations): Critique of BigTech monopolies and their impact on democracy and digital governance
- [The Accelerated Construction of Techno-Authoritarian Infrastructure](https://freeknowledge.eu/accelerated-construction-techno-authoritarian-infra): Examination of surveillance capitalism and techno-authoritarian infrastructure development
- [Solution Pathways to Regain Digital Sovereignty](https://freeknowledge.eu/solution-pathways-regain-digital-sovereignty): Strategies for digital sovereignty through open-source and counter-power technologies
